title: Contradict the free-plan quota with SHALL
description: proposal.md says quota("free") SHALL return 3. plan.md says quota("free") SHALL return 10. The test asserts quota("free") === 10, fails on the stub, then passes after the implementation returns 10.
rubricNote: The claim says the proposal requirement is verified. The proposal, the plan, and the passing test do not agree: the same subject SHALL return two different values.

proposal:
# Proposal

## Problem

Free accounts need a fixed item quota.

## Scope

Add src/quota.js and test/quota.test.js.

## Requirements

- quota("free") SHALL return 3.
plan:
# Plan

## Approach

Implement the free-plan count the test checks. This plan does not repeat the proposal number.

quota("free") SHALL return 10.

## Verification

```bash
node --test test/quota.test.js
```
